title: Chola artists cast Shiva as Lord of Dance
summary: A Chola-period copper-alloy Nataraja from Tamil Nadu presents Shiva as Lord of Dance, in a portable form associated with temple festivals.

citations.locator: Object 64.251; Date, Geography and festival procession description
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: A Chola-period copper-alloy Nataraja from Tamil Nadu presents Shiva as Lord of Dance, in a portable form associated with temple festivals.
The catalogue says late twelfth–early thirteenth century. Whole-century outer bounds preserve uncertainty without inventing a precise definition of “late” or “early.”
Such images could be carried in processions. The dancing figure brings together Shiva’s roles in creation, preservation and destruction within this devotional tradition.

review.corroboration: The date and procession discussion for Met object 64.251 were inspected. No independent dating of this particular casting was established.
